verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships GNOME Boxes, which per docs lets users select an OS and have the app handle VM creation with minimal manual setup, directly matching the story's intent. However, evidence is limited to a single first-party marketing line with no independent/hands-on corroboration of ease-of-use, speed, or workflow depth (e.g., snapshotting, CLI automation, cloud-image support). Missing for 10: independent verification of Boxes' quick-VM-creation experience, details on advanced VM management features, and any developer-specific tooling beyond the one-line docs claim.
